newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Duratex upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Duratex upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- BBV Latinvest said on Monday it had raised its rating on Brazil's Duratex S.A., a supplier of home building materials, to buy from hold.

-- "Brazil's economy is showing clear signs of a sustainable recuperation in industrial production, driven mainly by enhanced levels of investments by large parastatal companies which have received real tariff increases in the last year," analyst Patrick Granham wrote in a report.

-- "As a result, any stock with exposure to this cycle will be attractive at present. Brazil's stock market has very few liquid construction plays and, as such, we would view Duratex as a good alternative to a direct play on this market."
